tools.name: create_prize_draw
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a fair random pick of winners from a group: a giveaway, door prize, raffle without tickets, classroom or team pick. Publishes a draw page with a public link where entrants add their names (or only the organizer adds them), and returns a private organizer link. Optionally

tools.name: add_draw_entries
tools.description: Use this when the organizer wants to add entrant names to a draw made with create_prize_draw, before the winners are drawn. Takes the private organizer link and a list of up to 100 names per call (send more in further calls). Duplicate names (ignoring case) are skipped and reported. Does not draw; d

tools.name: draw_winners
tools.description: Use this when the organizer is ready to pick the winners of a draw made with create_prize_draw. Takes the private organizer link. Closes entries, picks the winners and backups with the published method, and reveals the seed on the public page so anyone can verify. The result is final: running it aga

tools.name: show_draw_results
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the state of a draw made with create_prize_draw: number of entries, the names, the commitment, and after the draw the winners, backups and proof values. Takes the private organizer link. Does not change the draw.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_prize_draw · Private data: create_prize_draw, add_draw_entries, draw_winners, show_draw_results · Public sink: add_draw_entries · Destructive: add_draw_entries, draw_winners.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_prize_draw · Private data: create_prize_draw, add_draw_entries, draw_winners, show_draw_results · Public sink: add_draw_entries · Destructive: add_draw_entries, draw_winners

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
